summary: Exited at +54.50pts on a confluence signature: three consecutive frames of lower highs after the peak (~92-108pts), ER10 efficiency ratio collapsing from 0.56 to 0.07 (trend turning choppy/inefficient), and all three fire detectors (KMDR, HA, PROPP) flipping to 'against' simultaneously for the first time in the episode. Earlier single-signal 'against' fires (frames 3-16) were repeatedly noise that the trade recovered from with new highs, so I held through those; what changed was the multi-signal confluence plus the ER crash, which together read as a structural break rather than normal chop. Next time I'd watch the ER10 decay rate more explicitly as an early warning before all three detectors align, since by the time all three agreed the price had already given back ~35-40pts from peak.
